title: World of stones
description:
This mod adds some new stone types 
Some include leafy stone Cobbled leafy stone polished leafy stone worn stone polished worn stone etc.
body:
_(This is a mod for minecraft that adds rocks)_

whenever you go caving do you feel that there isnt enough types of stones? well then this mod is for you! 

Whenever you go caving you will find 4 new types of stones **_(will add more in the future)_**
